scope: Implement the selected Grouped design across existing Companion pages and supporting views. Future provider, call and host-administration contracts remain gated.

foundations.appearance: Device light/dark palette, including Canvas and Markdown helpers

implemented: Shared GroupedSection, GroupSurface, PreferenceRow, PreferenceToggle and SheetHeading anatomy with readable large-text values and explicit accessible actions.
One app header, contextual chat options, center Voice dock and persistent active-voice controls; long-press dictation stays attached to the selected chat.
Open chat and room lists, search before sort/filter controls, accessible conversation open/long-press actions, separated section headings and retained list virtualization.
Rich-text composer kept with its selection transformations, visible formatting icons, vertical action stacks, draft-safe model/reasoning entry and expanded draft editing without submission.
Device overview with focused phone identity, Hands, permissions, notification stream/destination, protected rules and audit views; revoke confirmation and unchanged broker/arming policies.
Settings navigation with separate speech, background connection, readability, current capability and about views; scoped existing callbacks and a disconnect confirmation.
Hosts overview and focused add-host, connection, health/services, linked hosts, updates and background views; URL validation and confirmations for unlink/update.
Profiles and pickers with wrapping metadata; grouped session actions, model/reasoning, context and command controls.
Room creation grouped by templates, participants, rules, legacy policy and opening message while preserving the host contract.
Agent creation moved into a scrollable focused sheet, accessible session rows, consistent creation controls and retained terminal/structured-session/directory workflows.
Schedules grouped by active/paused, with real job detail, latest outcome, pause/resume and a single-run confirmation.
Git review uses distinct change sections, readable filenames/paths and an enclosed commit field. Commit messages survive failed submissions.
Voice start/controls use shared headings, a clear stage, muted/readiness feedback, grouped routing and existing exact-conversation navigation.
Connection/authentication retain their actual credential and pairing flows with clearer labels and consistent inputs.
unchanged_feature_gates: Host speech spoken recognition/conversation validation is deferred; build flag remains false.
Native realtime and incoming calling remain disabled. No simulated call history, provider result or host-administration success is shipped.
No mobile tool, notification protocol, canonical skill, prompt, broker guard, plugin deployment or host credential logic changed.
